claims: The USA will face the Dominican Republic in a 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET.
The Dominican Republic defeated Korea 10-0 in a mercy-rule victory to advance.
The USA defeated Canada 5-3 to advance.
The game is at loanDepot Park, Miami.
The game will be broadcast on Fox Sports 1 (FS1).
The winner advances to the 2026 WBC Final on Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
The Dominican Republic hit 14 home runs as a team in the tournament.
The USA lost to Italy in pool play.
Paul Skenes is expected to start for the U.S. in the semifinal.
The U.S. had a 2017 quarterfinal victory over the Dominican Republic.
This information is based on the World Baseball Classic scenario as of March 14, 2026.
